title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Advanced Project and Logistics Management
description: The course is designed to provide participants with expertise in managing complex projects and logistics operations with an Advanced Professional Certificate in Advanced Project and Logistics Management.
longDescription: The Advanced Professional Certificate in Advanced Project and Logistics Management covers lectures on project portfolio management, PMO, global supply chain ecosystem, and the role of IT in logistics and supply chain. The course provides students with a comprehensive understanding of project management concepts, including portfolio management tools and techniques. It also covers the features and benefits of PMOs, the nature of supply chain ecosystems, and the elements of supply chain delivery infrastructure. Lastly, the course explores the role of IT in logistics and supply chain, including logistics information systems, big data logistics, and logistics process integration frameworks.
